prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins.
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 6 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6), though 10 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, adoption hint, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Control Instructions Screen: Introduce a dedicated new screen at the end of onboarding displaying clear checklist instructions on using the system tray to control, show, or hide the desktop pet. (why: Support tickets show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to pets (3 emails) and desktop feature misbehavior (4 emails).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Sync Reassurance: Add a prominent sync reassurance hint explaining that signing into an existing account immediately retrieves and restores existing pets and progress. (why: The top support theme is pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 support emails).)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Activity Progress Status Stream: Display a dynamic status activity text component on the waiting screen explaining current background generation stages such as asset extraction and desktop tray hookup. (why: The home waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s, and wait_info changes have driven 4 past test wins.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting and Angle Guidance Notice: Add a clear photo quality hint recommending high-contrast lighting and clear front angles to avoid custom pet generation errors. (why: Support mail logged 3 reports of custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption is the main funnel drop point (66.2% conversion).)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Ready Desktop Alert Notification: Enable an optional desktop alert system prompt on the render screen that notifies users when rendering completes if the app is minimized. (why: Long background render times (median 201s, mean 2336s) cause users to minimize the app and lose track of onboarding.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split Stage Adoption Certificate View: Reorganize the adoption certificate screen into a split layout separating pet summary details from naming and confirmation controls. (why: Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off (66.2% conversion), indicating layout friction during certificate completion.)
